description: Adopt the W3C PROV-O vocabulary for artifact lineage. VERIFIED gap: feature.json artifact entries carry only {type, path, status} (contracts/feature-json.schema.json) — no derivation edge, no upstream reference, and canonical artifacts are auto-discovered rather than registered, so there is no edge to hang staleness on at all. Borrow the vocabulary (Entity/Activity/Agent, wasDerivedFrom, wasGeneratedBy, used), not the RDF stack, so staleness becomes a reachability query and an export stays possible later. Read the spec before designing anything custom. Anchor: docs/features/COMP-PROV-LINEAGE/plan.md
source: Semantica teardown 2026-08-08; re-grounded against code 2026-08-08 after design gate
